The camera is on the near pavement at head height behind the gas lamp; low sun from the LEFT. At the first frame the focus of the picture is the two walkers in the BOTTOM half at the CENTRE, <Subject 1> nearer and taller, <Subject 2> a step ahead and smaller. The gas lamp stands at the LEFT third the full height of the frame. Grey terraces fill the RIGHT third; plane trees shrink toward the CENTRE; pale sky fills the TOP quarter. The camera rises above the two walkers, looking down over the broad street and its plane trees across the whole shot as <Subject 1> walks with his head bowed, from 00:00 to 00:02. At 00:02 <Subject 2> swings his cane a step ahead of him, and the swing continues to the last frame of the shot. <Subject 1>'s mouth is closed from 00:00 to 00:05 while he walks with his head bowed. By 00:05 the camera is rising through the last frame, and the action continues with it, and a high view of the broad street, the two walkers small at the CENTRE on the near pavement, long shadows across the flagstones, the lamp top at the LEFT third.
